title: Edit a page in the builder
blurb: Change text and images, and add sections, rows and elements to a page.

steps.title: Open Funnels
steps.body: Click **Funnels**. (Website pages use the same builder.)

steps.title: Open a funnel
steps.body: Click the funnel you want to change. Its steps are listed down the left. Pick a step and click **Edit** to open the builder.

steps.title: How a page is built
steps.body: Pages stack in layers: a **section** is a full-width band, a **row** sits inside it and splits into columns, and **elements** (headline, image, button, form) sit in the columns.
steps.tip: You can drop an element straight onto the page and the builder makes the section and row for you.

steps.title: Add a section
steps.body: Hover between two sections and click the plus, or open the add panel on the left. Pick a blank section or a ready-made one, like a hero, testimonials or pricing.

steps.title: Add an element
steps.body: Open the elements list on the left and drag in what you need: text, image, video, button or form. Drop it where the blue line shows.

steps.title: Change the details
steps.body: Click any element to edit it. The panel on the right has **General** for content and links, and **Styles** for colour, spacing and borders.

steps.title: Save and check
steps.body: Click **Save** often, then **Preview** to see it as a visitor would. Saving does not change the live page until you click **Publish**.
